title: NSH: implement dissectors for TLVs defined in RFC9263
description:
MD Type 2 Context Header dissectors have been added for
following sections in RF9263:

- 4.1.  Forwarding Context
- 4.2.  Tenant ID
- 4.3.  Ingress Network Node Information
- 4.4.  Ingress Network Source Interface
- 4.5.  Flow ID
- 4.6.  Source and/or Destination Groups
- 4.7.  Policy ID

notes.body:
From the pipeline:

Warning: epan/dissectors/packet-nsh.c:309 proto_tree_add_item called for FT_UINT24 field "hf_nsh_tlv_forwarding_context_mpls_vpn_label"  - with bad encoding - "ENC_NA" - {'ENC_HOST_ENDIAN', 'ENC_LITTLE_ENDIAN', 'ENC_BIG_ENDIAN'} allowed
Warning: epan/dissectors/packet-nsh.c:368 proto_tree_add_item called for FT_UINT32 field "hf_nsh_tlv_source_group"  - with bad encoding - "ENC_NA" - {'ENC_HOST_ENDIAN', 'ENC_LITTLE_ENDIAN', 'ENC_BIG_ENDIAN'} allowed
Warning: epan/dissectors/packet-nsh.c:369 proto_tree_add_item called for FT_UINT32 field "hf_nsh_tlv_dest_group"  - with bad encoding - "ENC_NA" - {'ENC_HOST_ENDIAN', 'ENC_LITTLE_ENDIAN', 'ENC_BIG_ENDIAN'} allowed

Should these all be ENC_BIG_ENDIAN?  Could you please set them to this?  ENC_NA has the same value as ENC_BIG_ENDIAN, but it is preferable to explicit.

Sure.

I double-checked all data-types and encodings and made the necessary improvements.
